gen-fs-nippo-gf-lexend-deca: Nippo's lowercase stands nearly capital-sized, each stroke looking cut from wire. And Lexend Deca takes the other job, drawing one unshaded line with big lowercase and small-looking capitals that make paragraphs feel approachable.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-lexend-exa: Nippo goes technical and compact, its wire-cut letters standing almost at capital height. Lexend Exa then carries the reading, with wide curves that stay distinct and stubby ascenders, so paragraphs move along smoothly and cleanly.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-lexend-peta: Those wire-cut strokes of Nippo, with small letters standing almost at capital size, give the heading its technical edge. And Lexend Peta settles into a long read with wide-mouthed curves that never thin out, so paragraphs feel open and friendly.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-lexend-tera: Technical and crisp, Nippo cuts its letters like wire. Lexend Tera sits beneath it drawing a single plotter-pen line, with open curves and wide stepping-stone spacing that give the heading's compact forms something spacious to lean against.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-liter: Contemporary and sharp, Nippo cuts its letters like wire. Liter has no stroke contrast at all and wide mouths on its round forms, so give it a generous size and let its upright lowercase do the work.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-maven-pro: Nippo opens with wire-cut strokes and small letters that stand almost capital-sized. Maven Pro follows with a welcoming gap in its c and a gentle monotone line, so a long passage reads smoothly and without fuss.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-michroma: Technical is the mood in Nippo, whose wire-cut strokes carry no thick-and-thin contrast to slow the eye. But Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, with open curves and stubby ascender tips, and that spacing is what it does best.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-miriam-libre: Nippo comes in technical, with wire-cut strokes and proud small letters. Miriam Libre keeps a drawn-wire weight and an s with generous openings, so beneath the heading its cast-iron-sized lowercase feels friendly and sturdy.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One brings a very large lowercase eye and letters hung like clothespins on a line, all in one stroke width. Yet Nippo does the sharper work, its wire-cut strokes and near-capital small letters giving the heading a technical edge.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Nippo's small letters stand almost capital-sized, each stroke cut like wire. Mochiy Pop P One lets a wide stretch of space sit between its sizable lowercase letters, so under that crisp heading the text feels open and approachable.
